text: oh i am not getting that action to show up, because there is a layout bug, every single one of these that has text wrap is pushing the option out of scope [Image #1]
resolution: Fixed the UV context-menu layout bug that hid later Texture Atlas actions. Shared fixed-height context action labels are now single-line and shrink safely beside key hints; UV detail text is also single-line, and the popup was widened so descriptive actions remain readable. Texture Atlas's first-frame estimate now includes all eight actions, including Reset UV Layout, while the rendered menu's measured onLayout height becomes authoritative for panel-edge clamping so future rows or text metrics cannot push actions out of view. Added regressions for the shared no-wrap row contract and measured/fallback UV menu sizing; focused tests, editor bundle check, ReleaseFast ship, and doc-index bundle pass.
